validation.repositoryQa: No production source changed. Latest repository QA remains docs/inverse/datasets/editable-paper-qa.json: 924/925 inverse tests, unresolved short-routing timeout; no new green suite claimed.

findings: Expanded real supervision improves average material identity on the original nine and added eight, but lowers body IoU across all seventeen.
Current-solver replay improves learned joint acceptance from 2/17 to 3/17, losing boar while adding rabbit and stacked hearts. Production reaches 6/17 on this same dataset.

All fourteen expanded-joint failures stop at crop selection, not at template search. Some have almost zero observed material error, so lower-edge/lobe support and foreground quality remain separate limits.
Low error and physical legality can coexist with lost fine strokes or opened enclosed motifs. Derived-mask acceptance is not artwork or topology accuracy.
Sparse conservative labels omit many cutting boundaries; near-zero observed errors do not certify a usable full mask.
Additional photographs alone did not fix printed ink, similar paper colors, clutter, occlusions or fine details. No replacement model is justified.
nextWork: Measure controlled appearance sensitivity without changing geometry or labels, then test photo-conditioned paper identity or color augmentation on fixed grouped folds.
Use crop proposals and source-aware local refinement to retain high-resolution boundaries; do not accept failed geometry just because the neural fields have a low pixel score.
Address enclosure preservation and narrow boundary features in ordinary fitting and final exported-mask checks.

familyGroupingQualification.finding: The photo real-8c875dd0f298b5a4 is an ordinary checker with printed hearts. The historical appearance-based grouping placed it in framed-motif-family, so it entered real-image training when the other checker photographs were held out.
familyGroupingQualification.scope: Source and near-duplicate separation remain as recorded, and the saved metrics remain numerical observations. Do not interpret the historical split as complete real-checker-family holdout. Synthetic training already included checker geometry.
familyGroupingQualification.correction: Both new paired arms place this photograph in checker-family. The baseline is retrained under that corrected grouping before evaluating the additional/corrected supervision. Historical labels, checkpoints and predictions are preserved.
